env-panes-pane.report: Panes has no generic pane: its panes are env-panes-main and env-panes-supporting, or env-panes-list and env-panes-detail.

env-panes.report: Panes decides its arrangement in CSS and marks it with data-behavior, data-split-at and data-open, the pane shown in less room: it has no orientation or stacking, and while its divider is dragged the divider has data-dragging, so write .env-panes:has(> .env-panes-divider[data-dragging]) for data-resizing.

env-split-pane-probe.report: Panes measures nothing: CSS decides its arrangement from its own width, at splitAt, so the probe is gone.
